claims: YF-VAX is a yellow fever vaccine.
The yellow fever vaccine is a single-dose injection.
The yellow fever vaccine provides lifelong immunity against the virus for travelers aged 9 months or older visiting high-risk areas in Africa and South America.
The yellow fever vaccine must be administered at least 10 days before travel.
The yellow fever vaccine must be administered at designated, certified centers.
Yellow fever vaccine is recommended for travelers to endemic areas in Africa and South America.
Yellow fever vaccine is required for entry into specific countries.
A single dose of yellow fever vaccine provides 95% immunity within one week.
Immunity from a single dose of yellow fever vaccine generally lasts for life.
A single dose of yellow fever vaccine generally does not need a booster.
Side effects of yellow fever vaccine include headaches.
Side effects of yellow fever vaccine include muscle aches.
Side effects of yellow fever vaccine include low-grade fevers.
Rare severe reactions to yellow fever vaccine include allergic reactions.
Rare severe reactions to yellow fever vaccine include serious nervous system issues.
Rare severe reactions to yellow fever vaccine include serious organ issues.
The cost of the yellow fever vaccine and administration fee usually ranges from $150 to over $300.
An International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis (ICVP) is issued upon yellow fever vaccination.
ICVP is required for entry into many countries.
ICVP validates that the yellow fever vaccine was given at an authorized center.
